name: Euro stacking container 600 x 400 x 230 mm
description:
A solid-walled euro stacking container on the 600 x 400 mm footprint: the standard European small load carrier module, four of which fill a 1200 x 800 mm Euro pallet layer exactly. This is the single most common industrial tote in European warehousing, order picking and factory line-side supply.

External dimensions: length 600 mm, width 400 mm, height 230 mm.

600 x 400 mm footprint: the standard euro container module, four per 1200 x 800 mm Euro pallet layer. Same grid as the VDA 4500 small load carrier family.

GLB (glTF 2.0), real-world scale in metres, origin at the centre of the base. 2,964 triangles, flat PBR base colours, no textures. CC BY 4.0.
summary: Euro stacking container, 600 x 400 x 230 mm - true-scale GLB of the standard European small load carrier, for warehouse, logistics and inventory visualisation.
